tasks.short: Design and conduct nanotechnology product or process tests

steps.what: Design tests of the new nanotechnology product, process or system, setting hypotheses, sampling, controls, acceptance rationale and measurement conditions
Prepare and verify specimens, fixtures, calibration and contamination controls for the nanoscale test
Conduct actual nanotechnology tests and capture measurements, anomalies and failed cases in the laboratory-test category of {OTHER}
Analyze actual test results using native statistical and response plots in the laboratory-analysis category of {OTHER}; interpret uncertainty, write findings and check the complete test record
Save the exact checked nanoscale test snapshot in {DOCS}

tasks.design: Test native statistical and response-plot settings in the laboratory-analysis category of {OTHER}. Keep test design, physical preparation, actual measurements and scientific judgement human, then save the completed checked test record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated statistical and plot assembly can follow every test series.
tasks.enabler_now: Native analysis settings can reuse explicit groups and units.
tasks.still_hard: Specimen history, contamination and measurement artefacts can invalidate a precise result.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer distinguishes material or device behaviour from the measurement setup.

ambition.what: No automatic test acceptance or product release.

tasks.altitude: Less analysis setup, unchanged test responsibility.

reach.learn: Link each reading to preparation and actual test conditions.

evidence.claim: Configured laboratory plots can reduce repeated statistical assembly without establishing scientific validity.

assumptions: Boundary is a new nanotechnology test series and its record, excluding production qualification and other-role work. Physical preparation and measurement capture stay counted; test runtime earns no saving.

The engineer defines specimen ID, preparation, measurement, unit, calibration, control group and acceptance rationale in s1-s2 and captures actual results and failures in s3. Missing provenance requires manual investigation or retest, not inferred completion.
Native settings first. Shares are illustrative and unmeasured. Final s4 checking follows completed analysis and wording and binds the exact dataset and findings; edits void the save gate.
unknowns: Whether native statistical views already cover repeated work
research_questions: Which analysis assembly still consumes actual engineering time?

already_counted.description: Scientific analysis, interpretation and final record checking remain in s4.

incremental.description: Maintain validated analysis settings and changed measurement fields.

approvals.approved_version: Actual dataset, analysis and completed test finding checked in s4; edits require rechecking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Repeated statistical assembly saves 12.5 gross hours less 2 upkeep for 10.5 net. Existing native views give zero gain. Plan, specimens, actual tests and save retain effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define the nanosystem application and physical constraints, selecting the working principle and interfaces for the research design or prototype
Create designs for nanosystem applications in the nanoscale modelling and design category of {OTHER}, reusing native geometry, material and interface structures
Create and examine the actual research prototype, such as a nanoscale delivery structure or microscope component, capturing fabrication and observed behaviour
Assess prototype suitability and limitations and write and check the final design, preparation and evidence snapshot
Save the exact checked nanosystem prototype snapshot in {DOCS}

tasks.design: Test native geometry and interface reuse in the nanoscale modelling and design category of {OTHER}. Keep concept selection, actual prototype work and suitability judgement human, and save only the completed checked design and evidence snapshot.
tasks.previous_blocker: Related prototype designs can repeat geometry and material entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native design structures can reuse setup without selecting a physical mechanism.
tasks.still_hard: Nanoscale interactions and preparation effects may defeat the nominal design.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer judges what the actual prototype demonstrates and what it does not.

ambition.what: No clinical use, production release or new performance claim.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated model entry, unchanged prototype responsibility.

reach.learn: Connect measured properties to actual fabrication history.

evidence.claim: Native design structures can reuse model entry, while actual prototype behaviour requires physical evidence.

assumptions: Boundary is an early research prototype and internal record, not human use, product approval or production scale-up. Physical prototype work by the engineer is retained.

The engineer produces application requirement, geometry, material, units, interface and source versions in s1-s2 and actual fabrication, specimen and observed response in s3. Missing material or interface evidence requires manual investigation. The laboratory-prototype category of {OTHER} supports s3 capture; no free structured prototype evidence is assumed.
Native reuse first; illustrative shares are unmeasured. Final s4 checking follows completed design and actual evidence, with edits voiding the save gate.
unknowns: How much prototype design already uses native structures
research_questions: Which repeated design fields can be reused without hiding changed nanoscale assumptions?

already_counted.description: Model review and final prototype suitability checking remain in s2 and s4.

incremental.description: Maintain validated geometry and material definitions.

approvals.approved_version: Final prototype design and actual evidence checked in s4; edits require rechecking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Repeated design setup saves 5 gross hours less 1.5 upkeep for 3.5 net. Existing native structures give zero gain. Concept, actual prototyping, judgement and save retain effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write nanosystems funding or partnership proposals

steps.what: Define the nanosystems research programme, evidence, milestones, partner roles and fit to the actual funding or partnership call
Prepare explicit effort, equipment and partner budget scenarios in {SPREADSHEET}, using native totals and checking allowable-cost assumptions
Write the external-funding or company-partnership proposal in {DOCS}, using native call structure and a bounded draft only from the checked research and budget pack

loop.purpose: Draft proposal prose from the engineer's checked source pack.
loop.input: Call sections, numbered research claims with source passages, milestones, partner roles and checked budget.
loop.output: Section draft with a source reference for each scientific claim and no unsupported result or partner commitment.
loop.check: The engineer reads every claim against its source and checks meaning, uncertainty, milestones, partner authority and all budget references; missing evidence is not accepted because a citation exists.
loop.stop: One draft and at most one correction; unsupported claims, changed commitments or unresolved budget links return to manual writing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates and budget formulas are used first. Connecting checked research arguments into call-specific prose needs language judgement beyond field filling.

steps.what: Edit and check the completed proposal against the call, actual evidence, partner commitments, budget and authorised submission recipient
Save the exact checked proposal snapshot in {DOCS}
Send the exact versioned proposal to the checked authorised recipient through {EMAIL}

tasks.design: Test native call templates in {DOCS} and budget formulas in {SPREADSHEET}. A bounded model can draft prose from the checked pack, while the engineer verifies every scientific claim and commitment and checks the final version before separately saving and sending it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Call-specific prose and repeated budget arithmetic consume time after the programme is defined.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formulas and source-grounded draft suggestions can reduce assembly while keeping substantive review counted.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific merit, partner agreement and realistic milestones cannot be generated from a template.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer knows which proposed nanoscale result is plausible and which commitment is actually supported.

ambition.what: No new funding or partner commitment authority.

tasks.altitude: Less draft assembly, unchanged responsibility for the programme.

reach.task: Check call fit and allowable costs
reach.learn: Separate a persuasive scientific case from a compliant submission.

evidence.claim: Source-grounded proposal drafting and deterministic budget totals may reduce assembly time if complete scientific and commitment review is retained.

assumptions: Boundary is an existing proposal assignment through authorised submission, not contract execution or research work itself. The engineer must already have submission authority; other institutional or partner approvals remain with their existing owners and earn no saving.

The engineer produces actual research claim, passage reference, milestone, partner role and intended deliverable in s1. Rates and quotes have producer, date, currency and unit and are checked and entered in s2. Missing evidence or partner authority blocks the relevant claim; manual inquiry and capture are counted. No fabricated performance baseline is allowed.

Native templates and formulas first. Shares are illustrative and unmeasured. Final s4 checking follows the completed proposal and binds exact content, budget, commitments and recipient; edits void save and send approval.
unknowns: Whether a call allows assisted drafting
Who has authority for partner commitments and submission
research_questions: Does one real draft save time after source and commitment checking?

already_counted.description: Budget review, source-grounded draft review and final proposal checks remain in s2-s4.

incremental.description: Maintain call templates, source-pack structure and budget tests.

approvals.approved_version: Completed proposal and budget checked in s4; edits require rechecking.
Same final proposal checked in s4 and saved unchanged in s5, to the exact authorised recipient checked in s4.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Budget and prose assembly save 20.25 gross hours less 3 upkeep for 17.25 net in a suitable allowed call. Existing templates, restricted drafting or review-heavy proposals give zero benefit. Programme judgement and actions retain effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop nanoscale production processes and equipment needs

steps.what: Verify actual laboratory and pilot evidence, product tolerances, contamination constraints and intended production volume
Develop processes for pilot or commercial nanoscale production, choosing operations and addressing yield, contamination, handling and process interactions
Identify equipment needed for the route and compare explicit capacity, batch, utility and yield scenarios in {SPREADSHEET} using native formulas
Assess scaling uncertainty and practical equipment suitability and write and check the final proposed production route and equipment needs
Save the exact checked scale-up proposal in {DOCS}

tasks.design: Test native capacity and utility formulas in {SPREADSHEET}. The engineer develops the actual production route and judges equipment suitability and scaling uncertainty before saving the final checked proposal; nothing orders equipment or releases a process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Equipment and batch scenarios can repeat arithmetic across candidate routes.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formulas can reuse explicit capacity calculations.
tasks.still_hard: Laboratory yield and nanoscale handling may not transfer to production scale.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer knows when a supplier specification does not establish a viable process.

ambition.what: No equipment purchasing or process-release authority.

tasks.altitude: Less capacity arithmetic, unchanged scale-up judgement.

reach.learn: Check yield and handling assumptions rather than linearly scaling a laboratory result.

evidence.claim: Explicit batch and capacity formulas can reduce repeated comparison arithmetic without proving production feasibility.

assumptions: Boundary is proposed process and equipment identification, excluding actual production, procurement and qualification. Underlying prototype tests in 16542 or 16545 may be inputs, with no second credit here.

Pilot records supply batch, actual yield, cycle time, preparation and provenance. Equipment suppliers supply capacity, utility, unit and operating conditions. The engineer verifies and enters these in s1-s3; missing or incomparable data require manual inquiry and stay flagged.
Native formulas first. Shares are illustrative and unmeasured. Final s4 checking follows the completed proposal and binds route, equipment assumptions and limits; edits void the save gate.
unknowns: Whether native capacity worksheets already exist
research_questions: Which repeated arithmetic remains after production-route assumptions are understood?

already_counted.description: Equipment scenario review and final scaling assessment remain in s3-s4.

incremental.description: Maintain equipment unit definitions and capacity formula tests.

approvals.approved_version: Final production route, equipment assumptions and limitations checked in s4; edits require rechecking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Repeated capacity arithmetic saves 7.5 gross hours less 1.5 upkeep for 6 net. Existing formulas give zero gain. Route design, evidence checking and save retain effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Repeated statistical, proposal and capacity assembly can shrink while nanoscale design and physical evidence remain human.
reach: Work with laboratory, materials, process and funding specialists.
role.ambitious_version: An engineer who links each nanosystem claim, funding request and production proposal to actual evidence and stated limits.
